scope: K-odd spectral positivity on product Lichnerowicz operator

scalar_metric.TT_requires: f = const, giving q = g_A - g_B
scalar_metric.result: only negative TT mode is K-even

factor_tracefree_AA.result: P >= 4 in this sector, no negative modes

mixed_AB.result: P = 1 minimum in K-odd sector achieved by axial mode

conclusion.consequence: G_P^perp restricted to K-odd sector is well-defined and positive, but off-diagonal Green values at distinct nodes need not be positive

caveat: P >= 1 on K-odd sector does not determine the sign of the off-diagonal Green interaction sum_i!=j a_i b_j (eps_i eps_j - 1) K_{ij}^{11}. An off-diagonal matrix with zero diagonal is not positive-semidefinite in general.
